scope: Frozen external research evidence and received development feedback; not the current formal input loader or a new quality algorithm.

evidence.configs: 17 unchanged prior scalar configurations; source order preserved.
evidence.tables: Selected numeric metrics, saved candidate scores, record identity and source status; unavailable rows retained.
evidence.feedback: Latest received interpretation; raw_receipt and dataset_mapping retain distinct provenance.
evidence.qualification_snapshot: Prior qualification and exposure summary; copied for context, not new eligibility certification.
evidence.p05_input: Existing source point and pair indices are zero based. ERP coordinates use the declared 1024x512 frame.
evidence.provenance: Source roots, archive member, table filenames and extraction description. No SHA verification requested or performed.

audit.parity: Scalar recomputation compared only with saved cells. Missing expected cells and unavailable rows are reported separately.
audit.overall_pairs: Scores and signed A-minus-B differences. No numeric closeness threshold. Preference agreement stays null for C01/C02/C04.
audit.P04.top_only_penalty: Dimensionless 1-(1-flat_fraction)/(1+combined_top_height_loss), with neutral floor, bottom and structure; includes F where configured. Not a causal or independently reconstructed geometry component.
audit.P04.actual_top_height_score_drop: Score points lost against removal of top/height/F while retaining each record's floor, bottom and direction terms; cross-image baselines differ.
audit.P04.actual_top_height_relative_drop: Fraction lost relative to that record-specific counterfactual; null when its score is zero.
audit.P04.P04_direction_agrees_under_declared_: S034 has larger top_only_penalty than T20 under this declared interpretation. Development agreement, not correctness certification or human accuracy.
audit.P04_conditional_boundaries: Strict upper bound on hc only for fixed T20/S034 metrics, relative mean-error square sum and no F; not a universal threshold.
audit.P05.pairs: Existing pairing, current before-preprocessing x, periodic shared midpoint and pair azimuth gap. Gap degrees are not full ray angles.
audit.P05.input_quality_grade: Null; no grade inferred from residuals or processed geometry.
audit.controlled_results: Existing synthetic cases and two post-feedback scalar probes; no synthetic human grades. Camera-domain and unavailable states preserved.
audit.probe_definitions: Two declared post-feedback identification probes; no grid search, cutpoint fitting or independent-validation claim.

invariants: Raw feedback is not overwritten; unknown confidence and unreviewed input are not imputed.
Geometries, references, pairing, rings and formal worker eligibility are not modified.
The new evidence snapshot is not an additional independent sample or official input.
Mean-height direction is never inferred from absolute Hmean for log scoring.
No aggregate human pass rate is formed from unlike overall, close, top-only and input-review protocols.
